changes: Added 'Preview Before Sending' button to the agent-facing InspectionsPlusSheet (buyer/seller Inspections+ flow) — previously only the admin InspectionsPricingPanel had a preview; agents creating an order in the field had none.

Added a new stateless POST /api/inspection-orders/preview-draft endpoint that renders the exact client email (via buildInspectionOrderEmailHtml, same as the real send path) from in-memory form state before any DB row exists.

Added 'Preview Before Sending' button to the agent-facing RepairConsultSheet, reusing the existing by-id GET /api/repair-consults/:id/preview endpoint and ClientPreviewModal (no backend change needed there — consultId already persisted by that point in the flow).
Extended ClientPreviewModal to accept an optional draftFetcher prop (stateless fetch) as an alternative to the existing id-based GET fetch.
__bundleNotes: 'Preview Before Sending' is the new button label shared by both InspectionsPlusSheet and RepairConsultSheet. 'inspection-orders/preview-draft' is the literal new endpoint path called from InspectionsPlusSheet's draftFetcher. Both must appear in the live bundle to confirm this build shipped, not v20.32.25.
